title: FallbackPolicy
description: The named deterministic-first-then-fallback policy a rule references. It encodes the M7 contract: the deterministic rule runs FIRST on its scope; on a trigger (low confidence / unknown / out-of-distribution / abstain / schema mismatch) control falls back to the single LLMGateway, a human reviewer, the existing deterministic authority, or a hold-out — and the fallback is RECORDED (fallback_recorded pinned true) so those cases feed future mining. Every active rule MUST reference a fallback policy; a 'never_fallback' target is forbidden by the enum. Deterministic when created_at is injected.

default_fallback_target.description: where uncertain cases go; 'never_fallback' is NOT an allowed value — every rule must have a real fallback

triggers.description: the conditions that activate the fallback; at least one required

confidence_threshold.description: below this rule confidence the low_confidence trigger fires; optional

fallback_recorded.description: structurally pinned true: every fallback is recorded as a trace

feeds_future_mining.description: structurally pinned true: recorded fallback cases become future mining input
